svg.title: Cost-guided semantic merge execution
svg.desc: Abstract sorted runs inform a cost model. Feasible merge structures are evaluated for the requested mode, and the selected parameters configure either full materialization or demand-driven LIMIT execution. Solid push arrows return requested results downstream. Dashed pull arrows request data upstream; requests stop at K outputs or end of input.

g.desc: Documents and NL Query enter a shared planning-input bundle. Four hollow ports associate all four cards with this bundle; undirected branches do not imply that capacity or requested mode are computed from document text.
